content: Hello, I am Beacon Assurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking.
Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you please tell me your policyholder code?
Could you please tell me your year of birth?

Thank you. I am calling about overdue insurance premiums. Your motor premium has 480.00 past due and is 3 days late. Your home premium has 360.00 past due and is 3 days late. Can you pay the full past-due amounts for all of these today?
Actually, I paid both overdue premiums yesterday, the motor and the home amounts, so they should already be taken care of.
Thank you. Please note that posting a payment may take two business days. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
